ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with high-intensity (white) regions comprising approximately 35% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large white contiguous patch on the medial-lower quadrant of the left lobe; dense horizontal white linear patterns on the right lobe; solid black pigmentation along the central peduncle attachment point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 120 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-10 pixels; highest irregularity observed near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the median notch extending laterally, terminating in irregular jagged tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Large, textured, high-contrast clusters of barnacles at both the left and right distal tips; scattered circular white depigmented spots on the central fluke body.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned white linear rake marks across both lobes, with a high concentration of parallel horizontal lines on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization forming irregular masses at the lobe tips; extensive rake marks covering approximately 40% of the visible surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive 3D textured masses (barnacles) creating a non-linear profile at the extreme lateral edges.
